method: One warm-up; six-variant sequences balance positions and directed predecessors per six repetitions. reference/control component models freeze 0.22.0 keys/map reservation and stable block sorting; current/current_control use production storage/sort helpers. All models share validated canonical keys, stable distinct compaction and existing result reservation. Actual source/full evaluator intervals run in separate fresh arenas with paired controls. Component models omit AST/path traversal: their times are not substituted for actual full-query times, and intervals are not summed. Inputs parsed, ASTs compiled and ordinary outputs captured before measurement. Every model source/result and actual output matches public execution bytes. Encoding/checks/cleanup excluded from actual timers; component gaps include report work outside phase timers. Logical request deltas are above the temporary region, backing peaks include earlier live phases and cleanup reaches zero. Parse cost is outside these intervals; matched public CLI evidence covers complete invocations.
